title: Vegan Smoky Okonomiyaki Cabbage Delight
description: A vegan twist on the Japanese classic, this smoky okonomiyaki cabbage delight is a flavorful and satisfying dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together rice flour, okonomiyaki sauce, sesame oil, and soy sauce.
Add the shredded cabbage and crumbled smoked tofu to the bowl and mix well.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the cabbage mixture into the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the okonomiyaki and cook for another 2-3 minutes or until golden brown.
Repeat with the remaining cabbage mixture.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped green onions.
